title: ornus strigata
intro: Ornus strigata, commonly known as the Buckthorn or European Buckthorn, is a shrub or small tree species belonging to the family Rhamnaceae. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating digestive issues, making it beneficial for promoting overall health and well-being.
